decisions.statement: This script runs on every render.
A value this script cannot read is left out rather than said to be unknown.
A seat is read from the page representing that seat in akasha.
The count of live children is read by code outside akasha.
The usage the payload observed is kept by code outside akasha.
A client reaches this script by a link outside every checkout.

definition: the line under an agent's prompt saying what it is and what it has
